scope: TARE Scene4 follow-up only; GBP2 stays paused
control_settings: Original configuration and native binary; passive subscriber only
candidate_hypothesis: TARE native relocation momentum can reduce repeated direction reversals in corridor-like Scene4 and thereby reduce both path length and turning delay
candidate_origin: Existing native TARE feature, enabled in upstream tunnel.yaml; it is an engineering configuration experiment, not a proven bug fix or the paper authors' configuration
selection_rule: Keep raw data for every trial. Assess completed coverage and health first; only compare completed time/distance. Do not accept lower completion coverage, higher speed cap, truth targets, metric changes, or early stopping as improvement.
repeat_policy: At least one new unchanged control and one complete candidate. If candidate is adopted, run an independent fresh candidate confirmation before reporting it as recommended. No cherry-picking or claims of five-run statistical replication.
stochastic_limit: Upstream local sampler uses std::random_device; unmodified trials are not paired deterministic seeds. Small-sample differences cannot prove causal improvement.
